subject: Request: SDK backward-compat exemption + hotfix timeline
messages:
From: Anita Patel <apatel@signalforge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: integrations@signalforge.com
Date: 2027-08-29T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Breaking change impact: request for SDK grace window and hotfix

Hi Vanessa,

We just validated our releases against the upcoming Redwood API v2.0 preview and found a breaking change: the /v1/streaming/generate endpoint is scheduled for removal in favor of a unified /v2/generate that changes the streaming framing and auth header semantics. That change will cause SignalForge's SDK-based live transcription feature to fail for any customers still on our bundled SDK.

Attached is a short compatibility matrix (compat-matrix.xlsx) showing the delta across our top-10 enterprise customers. Many customers are mid-rollout and can't switch SDKs before Q4. Can Redwood provide either: (a) a 60–90 day grace period where /v1/streaming/generate remains available behind a compatibility flag for partner tenants, or (b) a small runtime-side hotfix that reintroduces an alias endpoint that preserves the current streaming frames?

We need an initial decision by Tuesday (2027-08-31) to align our rollout and customer comms. Happy to hop on a quick call—Anita.

--
Anita Patel
Head of Integrations, SignalForge Inc.
apatel@signalforge.com
+1 (415) 555-0197
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <apatel@signalforge.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, integrations@signalforge.com
Date: 2027-08-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Breaking change impact: request for SDK grace window and hotfix

Thanks for the matrix, Anita — I appreciate the urgency and the clear breakdown. Looping in Jonas and Marissa from Partnerships and our runtime lead Karthik (cc'ed) so we can evaluate technical/ops options and provide a timeline.

Prelim ask: can you confirm the top three enterprise customers affected and whether any require E2E encryption (HSM-managed keys) on the streaming path? That will affect whether a runtime alias is sufficient or whether a client-side shim is required.

We will triage internally today and aim to come back with a proposed mitigation by COB Tuesday. If acceptable, Jonas will propose a short joint customer comms note to align messaging.

Attachment: received compat-matrix.xlsx (we'll review)

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
--
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: SignalForge SDK compatibility ask — options and recommended path

Vanessa / Marissa / Karthik,

I reviewed Anita's matrix and spoke with runtime yesterday. Quick summary and recommended plan:

- Impact: The streaming framing in v2 changes the chunk header and auth refresh cadence; most SignalForge customers will see dropped frames and auth failures unless the client code updates. Top three affected customers are: Acme Health, Bloom Retail, and FiscalOne (Anita confirmed).

- Constraints: Acme Health uses customer-managed keys; we cannot proxy/decrypt for them without their explicit consent. FiscalOne has strict audit windows but can accept short-lived compatibility flags.

Options:
1) Backcompat alias (recommended short-term): Provide /v1/streaming/generate as a tenant-scoped alias for SignalForge for 90 days behind a feature flag. Low infra cost; preserves current semantics.
2) Runtime shim: Add an on-the-fly framing adapter for requests identified by partner token. Slightly more engineering work but transparent for partners.
3) SDK shim: Provide SignalForge with a small patch (signalforge_sdk_patch_v1.1.zip) they can distribute; this is fastest but requires their release cadence.

Recommendation: Combine 1 + 3: push a tenant-scoped alias for 90 days and provide the SDK patch so SignalForge can start rolling customers to the long-term v2 path. Proposed timeline:
- 2027-08-31: confirm decision with partner (we meet Anita's deadline)
- 2027-09-03: infra patch to enable alias (internal canary)
- 2027-09-07: public docs + compatibility flag exposed to partner tenants
- 2027-09-21: scheduled deprecation reminder (30 days before alias removal)

Action items / owners:
- Karthik: scope infra change + security review (HSM/cmk constraints) — Jira RW-6731 assigned.
- Marissa: prepare partner comms and joint support playbook.
- Vanessa: confirm list of affected customers and organize customer test windows with SignalForge.

I'll update the Jira with technical notes and link the API test vectors.

Cheers,
Jonas
Director, Partnerships (acting)
--
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <apatel@signalforge.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-31T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Breaking change impact: request for SDK grace window and hotfix — plan and next steps

Anita,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the matrix. We have an approved path forward from Partnerships + Runtime: Redwood will enable a tenant-scoped compatibility alias that preserves the current /v1/streaming/generate semantics for SignalForge partner tenants for an initial 90-day window, plus we will deliver the SDK patch you proposed to accelerate migration.

Planned milestones:
- 2027-09-03: internal infra change deployed to canary (Karthik to confirm by 9/2).
- 2027-09-07: compatibility flag visible in Partner Console; docs published at https://docs.redwood.com/partner/signalforge-v1-compat (draft link).
- 2027-09-21: reminder to all affected customers; joint support playbook executed.
- 2027-12-05: expected alias removal date (90 days after 9/7) — we will send a 30/14/7-day countdown.

Deliverables we will share this week:
- SDK patch (signalforge_sdk_patch_v1.1.zip) — internal QA passed, attaching stub here for your release team.
- Compatibility matrix review (we reviewed your spreadsheet).
- Joint comms draft and support runbooks (Marissa will circulate).

Please confirm you can test in your staging tenants on 9/8–9/10. If so, we'll lock the canary deployment for 9/3. If any of the top customers have additional requirements around HSM or audit logs (Acme Health was flagged), call that out and we'll escalate to security.

Attachments: signalforge_sdk_patch_v1.1.zip (patch stub), compat-matrix.xlsx (received)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this smoothed out quickly.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
